proposal.hypothesis: The measured scalar interleaves at widths 2 and 4 were slower than width 8, while width 12 was close to width 8 and width 16 was substantially slower. An explicitly unrolled six-pixel group tests whether a narrower-than-eight group retains useful independent recurrence work with less live state. It preserves per-pixel escape tests, counts, coordinate expressions, and recurrence order; the result must be measured, not inferred.

retained: Interleave six independent scalar pixel states per full group using separate coordinates, recurrence state, activity flags, and iteration counts.
Retain the original per-pixel escape test and recurrence expression order; inactive pixels stop updating while remaining pixels continue through the group loop.
Use the original float coordinate formulas for each column and preserve the scalar Mandel routine for any row tail shorter than six pixels.
Overwrite every output element; leave the run interface, OpenMP scheduling, and compiler configuration unchanged.
